name: Murray Buttes
crs: Mars planetocentric lon/lat (deg E), sphere R=3396190 m; local metres east/north

dtm.origin: row 0 = north edge, col 0 = west edge; rows increase to the south

walk.height_m: value / 100 (scene height, add z_offset_dtm_m for DTM elevation)
walk.slope_note: central difference over 1 m; mesh is smoother than the DTM in places

transform_walk_to_dtm.model: east_m = cos(t)*x + sin(t)*z ; north_m = -sin(t)*x + cos(t)*z ; dtm_col = cx + east_m / cell_m ; dtm_row = cy - north_m / cell_m ; dtm_elev = scene_y + z_offset_dtm_m
transform_walk_to_dtm.note: scene z axis points NORTH (z mirrored vs. a right-handed Y-up map); see README
